answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The terrace holds work receipts rather than names, so the cedar of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the thread is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
